AUD 'trapdoor opens' and is 'pulverised by US boom' — significant downside pressure on AUD/USD
Unemployment hits 5-year high yet RBA signals continued hiking — stagflation risk elevated
Oil jumps amid energy hysteria; Trump diesel export ban flagged as Australian nightmare
Housing prices over halfway to largest 40-year decline; >50% of renters financially stressed
Intergenerational Report 2026 underscores urgent tax reform need
Mining exploration active: Rio2 Peruvian copper, Auric/Aureka/Forrestania gold, Lindian rare earths
Jetstar industrial action escalates; staff waiving fees as dispute intensifies
Trump effect widening cracks in global financial markets; China-geopolitical tensions rising

sectors.trend: Exploration momentum strong across copper (Rio2, Sarytogan), gold (Auric, Aureka, Forrestania, Manhattan), and rare earths (Lindian). However, bond yield spike pressures high-beta miners. Oil jump supports energy names.
sectors.implications: Juniors with exploration upside (Aureka, Forrestania, Lindian) offer relative value vs large-cap miners hit by rate sensitivity. Copper/gold hedges inflation. BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin pressure from higher rates but supported by commodity prices.

sectors.trend: RBA hiking despite 5-year high unemployment creates NIM tailwind but credit risk rises. Bond yield spike pressures bank valuations. Intergenerational Report flags fiscal pressure.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX benefit from wider spreads but face rising provisioning. REITs (listed via ^AXJO) pressured by higher yields and falling property values.

sectors.trend: Oil jumps; 'energy hysteria' accelerates. Data centre boom drives electricity demand. Trump diesel export ban threatens Australian fuel supply chain. $1B energy showdown at historic Sydney site.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, SXG.AX benefit from oil spike. Energy infrastructure and renewables names gain from data centre demand. Diesel ban risk is a structural supply shock for transport and agriculture.

sectors.trend: Jetstar industrial action escalates. Qantas outback pricing backlash. Renters financially stressed. Housing correction deepens. McDonald's adapts to Ozempic demand shift.
sectors.implications: QAN.AX faces margin pressure from Jetstar (JST.AX) industrial action and pricing disputes. Consumer staples (WES.AX, WOL.AX) see defensive rotation. Property sector under severe stress.

sectors.trend: US AI chip race intensifies (Nvidia, AMD, Intel, Lumentum). Data centre energy demand links to Australian power sector. CSL.AX stable but global bond turmoil pressures growth valuations.
sectors.implications: ASX tech exposure limited; indirect benefit via data centre energy demand. CSL.AX, SGH.AX offer defensive quality. US AI trade volatility spills into global risk appetite.

key_themes: Bond market turmoil driving global equity sell-off; 'will bonds crash stocks' question central
AUD in freefall — 'trapdoor' and 'pulverised' language signals structural USD strength
Stagflation risk: 5-year high unemployment + RBA still hiking
Trump trade policy (diesel ban, regime change rhetoric) creating asymmetric downside for Australia
Housing correction: largest 40-year decline underway; renter stress >50%
Intergenerational Report 2026: fiscal sustainability crisis demands tax reform
Mining exploration pipeline robust across copper, gold, rare earths
Energy transition accelerated by data centre demand but 'energy hysteria' risks overbuild

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Bond yield spike / global bond market turmoil
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce duration exposure; favour short-duration and floating-rate instruments; increase allocation to real assets (mining, energy) as inflation hedge
Hedge AUD exposure; favour export-oriented miners (BHP.AX, RIO.AX) whose revenues are USD-denominated; avoid import-heavy consumer names

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Stagflation: RBA hiking into rising unemployment
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight energy and materials; underweight rate-sensitive REITs and growth; monitor RBA communications for pivot signals

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Trump diesel export ban / trade policy shock
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor fuel supply chain; favour domestic energy producers (WDS.AX, WLE.AX); assess transport sector exposure
Underweight property developers and REITs; favour consumer staples with pricing power (WES.AX, WOL.AX)
Avoid QAN.AX and JST.AX near-term; monitor for resolution catalysts

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight large-cap miners with USD revenue exposure
opportunities.rationale: AUD weakness and commodity strength (oil, copper, gold) provide dual tailwind; exploration pipeline (Rio2, Auric, Lindian) signals sector confidence

opportunities.recommendation: Add energy infrastructure and oil & gas names
opportunities.rationale: Oil jump, data centre power demand, and diesel ban risk create structural energy premium; 'energy hysteria' may overcorrect but near-term tailwind intact
Multiple high-grade discoveries (Auric Munda, Aureka VIC, Forrestania 210k oz, Manhattan Jaws) signal active gold exploration cycle; gold hedges bond turmoil

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce REIT and property developer exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Largest 40-year house price decline underway; >50% renters stressed; rising yields compress valuations; CBD tower sales at $40m signal distress pricing
Jetstar industrial action, Qantas pricing backlash, and renter stress suppress consumer spending; Ozempic shift pressures food demand

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain cash / short-duration bonds as bond turmoil resolves
defensive_moves.rationale: Bond market instability creates volatility; positioning for potential yield normalisation offers entry point once panic subsides

market_outlook.short_term: ASX under pressure from bond yield spike, AUD weakness, and RBA hawkish stance. Expect continued volatility in ^AXJO. Energy and materials outperform; REITs and consumer lag. Jetstar action adds idiosyncratic risk. 1–3 month range likely choppy with downside bias until bond market stabilises.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautious. Stagflation risk (high unemployment + RBA hikes) constrains earnings growth. Intergenerational Report 2026 signals fiscal tightening ahead. Housing correction may deepen. Mining and energy remain structural beneficiaries of AUD weakness and commodity demand. RBA pivot likely by mid-2027 if unemployment sustains 5-year highs.
